correctness.rationale: The standard duad–syntheme incidence model has 15 duads and 15 matchings and hence a 3-regular, 30-vertex graph; open-neighbor majority has no ties. Each update swaps the shores through exact 15-bit maps Phi and Psi. Independent complete enumeration of all 32768 states per shore reproduced G^3=G^2, J^3=J^2 and G^2!=G; 2386 fixed symbols on each shore; 2386 full fixed states; (2386^2-2386)/2=2845305 primitive two-cycles; and all five first-entry period-specific populations. The period-1 terminal-fiber formula was explicitly recomputed, not inferred from a log. Relabelling the six symbols yielded 156 ordinary graph classes and precisely 18 stable classes of prescribed sizes. The shore factorization, rather than a sample of 2^30 states, proves F^6=F^4 and the complete billion-state count. The provided width-four time witness establishes sharpness.

evidence: General known bound says eventual cycles have length at most 2, with various upper bounds on stabilization times; not the sharp F^6=F^4 for this graph.
